package.description: Tool for creating compact, flexible software installers for Windows.

en-GB.description: Tool for creating compact, flexible software installers for Windows.
en-GB.longDescription: InstallMate 11 is a development tool for creating software installers for Windows. It produces compact installers that support Windows XP through Windows 11 and Windows Server 2003 through 2025, cover x86, x64, and ARM64 platforms, and offer multilingual user interfaces, customisable behaviour, and code signing. Installers created with an unregistered copy stop working after four hours; a registered licence unlocks royalty-free distribution.
en-GB.name: InstallMate 11

zh-CN.description: 用于创建紧凑、灵活的 Windows 软件安装程序的工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: InstallMate 11 是一款用于创建 Windows 软件安装程序的开发工具。它生成的安装程序体积小巧，支持从 Windows XP 到 Windows 11 以及从 Windows Server 2003 到 2025 的系统，覆盖 x86、x64 和 ARM64 平台，并提供多语言用户界面、可定制行为和代码签名。使用未注册副本创建的安装程序会在四小时后停止工作；注册许可可解锁免版税分发。
